# Conner Plumbing

#### Based in Pompano Beach, Serving all of Broward county.

Based in Fort Lauderdale since 1953, the Conner family incorporated Conner Plumbing in 1995. The father-son team has since served Broward County residents and businesses in all plumbing matters, from [leak repairs](https://www.connerplumbing.com/services/water-leak-detection-repair/) to total renovations. Our technicians are very experienced professionals who work to solve your problems with the same care we would our own. Conner Plumbing is dedicated to getting your job done on time and on budget.

[Our Plumbing Services](https://connerplumbing.com/service/)
